title: A&C Case Study Frontmatter
description: Extends the base contract with the display metadata the corporate website needs to render case-study cards and detail pages. Applies to documents under core-developer-portal/case-studies/. This file is the single source of truth: the org CI validator enforces it on those paths, and the website derives its Zod schema from it (no divergence).

title.description: Case-study title used as the card and page heading.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'approved' documents are published to the public site; all others are checked out but excluded from the build.

source_doc.description: Provenance of the content (origin document, note, or generation method).

lang.description: Primary language of the document; drives the site's i18n routing (/es, /en).

summary.description: One- or two-line teaser shown on cards and used as the page meta description.

sector.description: Client industry, e.g. "Construction Materials". Always anonymized — never a client name.

scale.description: Scope/scale indicator, e.g. "Global - 600+ plants" or "National - 8M users".

tags.description: Technology / theme chips, e.g. ["Azure", "SAP BTP", "Zero Trust"].

hero_image.description: Path or key to an abstract, NDA-safe sector visual. Never a client photo or logo.

featured.description: Promote this case study on the homepage.

order.description: Explicit display order within listings (lower appears first).

case_id.description: Stable two-digit id (e.g. "01") linking the es-MX and en-US versions of the same case study.
